hero.badge: For local makers and artisans who sell in person
hero.subtitle: Online shop in 2 minutes. Click & collect, local delivery, integrated payments.

problem.titleLine2: Your customers don't have opening hours.
problem.body1: Whether you have a market stall, a shop, or a workshop — when you're not there, you're not selling. The customer who walks past your closed door on Sunday, the one who discovers you on Instagram at 11pm, the one who misses your market this month…
problem.body2: Boumly is the link you put everywhere — on your window, your packaging, your Instagram — letting anyone order, pay, and choose how to collect, at any time.

steps.title: Create
steps.desc: Shop name, your products, a photo. Boom — you're live. No technical skills. No templates. No headaches.

steps.title: Set up delivery
steps.desc: Click & collect at your workshop, delivery in your area, shipping across the country. Choose what works for you. Change it whenever you like.

steps.title: Share and sell
steps.desc: One link. On Instagram, TikTok, your market table, your packaging. Customers order, pay, and you get a notification.

features.title: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.
features.subtitle: Built for makers, not engineers.

items.title: Live in 2 minutes
items.description: No domain to configure, no hosting to manage. You create, you publish, you're online.

items.title: Pick-up at your workshop
items.description: Customers choose their slot. You prepare. They collect. Simple.

items.title: Deliver in your area
items.description: Set your zone (5 km, 10 km…) and your fee. We automatically check if the customer qualifies.

items.title: Made-to-order, stress-free
items.description: Customers order in advance with a notice period you choose. You only make what's already sold.

items.title: Reward your regulars
items.description: Create codes for loyal customers, special markets, or seasonal promotions.

items.title: Take payment anywhere
items.description: Got an order directly at the market? Create it yourself and send a payment link by SMS.

why.title: Before Boumly / After Boumly.
why.subtitle: The change fits in one column.

rows.traditional: You only sell when you're physically there

rows.boumly: They order from your link at any time

rows.traditional: Cash payments you forget to track

items.quote: I have a shop open 4 days a week. The rest of the time I was losing sales. With Boumly, my customers order when it suits them and pick up when I'm there.
items.name: Marie

items.quote: I work to order from my workshop. Before it was WhatsApp + bank transfer + stress. Now customers order, pay, and I prepare. Clean and simple.
items.name: Thomas

items.quote: I do markets at the weekend. During the week my customers couldn't find me. Now they order from my Instagram link and come pick up whenever they want.
items.name: Yasmine
